mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP (FLAGGED_DOC_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, STATENO, REASON_ID, CREATE_UID, CREATE_DATE) VALUES(#{triggeringDocId, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{triggeringDocId, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{triggeringStateno, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reason, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: select count(*) as ct from NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP where DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId} and RESOLUTION_ID is null

SELECT distinct f.followup_id_pk followupidpk, f.document_id documentid, pdc.stateno stateno, f.reason_id reasonid, frea.reason_desc reasondesc, f.create_uid createuid, usr.full_name createname, to_char(create_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') createdate, f.resolution_id resolutionid, fres.resolution_desc resolutiondesc, f.resolution_uid resolutionuid, usr2.full_name resolvername, to_char(resolution_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') resolutiondate FROM NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP f, CODED_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_REASON frea, CODED_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_RESOLUTION fres, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr2, person_doc_association pdc WHERE f.document_id = #{documentId} and f.document_id = pdc.document_id and f.create_uid = usr.worker_id(+) and f.reason_id = frea.reason_id (+) and f.resolution_id = fres.resolution_id (+) and f.resolution_uid = usr2.worker_id(+) and pdc.association_status_code not in ('DISASSOC_UNMRG', 'DISASSOC_MRG') order by resolutiondate desc, createdate desc

SELECT distinct f.followup_id_pk followupidpk, f.document_id documentid, pdc.stateno stateno, f.reason_id reasonid, frea.reason_desc reasondesc , create_uid createuid, usr.full_name createname, to_char(create_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') createdate FROM NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP f, CODED_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_REASON frea, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr, person_doc_association pdc WHERE f.resolution_id is null and f.document_id = pdc.document_id and pdc.dissassociation_date is null and f.create_uid = usr.worker_id(+) AND f.reason_id = frea.reason_id (+)
SELECT document_id, stateno, nu.EMAIL_ADDR FROM NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP nf, NYEHMS_USERS_VW nu WHERE followup_id_pk = #{followupIdPk} and nf.CREATE_UID = nu.WORKER_ID(+)
select RESOLUTION_ID, RESOLUTION_DESC from CODED_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_RESOLUTION where RESOLUTION_ID != 12
mapper.update: UPDATE NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP SET RESOLUTION_ID = #{resolutionId}, RESOLUTION_UID = #{workerId}, RESOLUTION_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE FOLLOWUP_ID_PK = #{followupIdPk} and RESOLUTION_ID is null
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NYEHMS_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_COMMENTS (FOLLOWUP_ID_PK, COMMENTS, LAFT_USER, COMMENT_DATE, INITIAL_COMMENT) VALUES (#{followupIdPk, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{comments, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{initialComments, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT f.followup_id_pk followupidpk, f.document_id documentid, pdc.stateno stateno, f.reason_id reasonid, frea.reason_desc reasondesc, f.create_uid createuid, usr.full_name createname, to_char(create_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') createdate, f.resolution_id resolutionid, fres.resolution_desc resolutiondesc, f.resolution_uid resolutionuid, usr2.full_name resolvername, to_char(resolution_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') resolutiondate FROM NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP f, CODED_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_REASON frea, CODED_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_RESOLUTION fres, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr, NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr2, person_doc_association pdc WHERE f.resolution_id is not null and f.document_id = pdc.document_id and f.create_uid = usr.worker_id(+) and f.reason_id = frea.reason_id (+) and f.resolution_id = fres.resolution_id (+) and f.resolution_uid = usr2.worker_id(+) and pdc.association_status_code not in ('DISASSOC_UNMRG', 'DISASSOC_MRG')

SELECT usr.full_name || ' ' || to_char(fc.comment_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') || ' ' || fc.comments as reviewComments FROM NYEHMS_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_COMMENTS fc , NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr WHERE followup_id_pk = #{followupIdPk} and initial_comment is null and fc.laft_user = usr.worker_id(+) order by comment_date desc

SELECT to_char(fc.comment_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') || ' ' || fc.comments as initialComments FROM NYEHMS_LAFT_FOLLOWUP_COMMENTS fc , NYEHMS_USERS_VW usr WHERE followup_id_pk = #{followupIdPk} and initial_comment = 'Y' and fc.laft_user = usr.worker_id(+) order by comment_date desc
mapper.update: UPDATE NYEHMS_FLAG_LAFT_FOLLOWUP SET RESOLUTION_ID = 12, RESOLUTION_UID = #{workerId}, RESOLUTION_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId} and RESOLUTION_ID is null
